interface_regression.scope: Small local non-inference regression: public CNRPark original crop decoding and synthetic human notes; shipped synthetic incident demo. No model execution, output mocking or product modifications.
interface_regression.result: No blocking UI regression found in the four focused workflows.
verified: Public CNRPark B52 original crop decodes at 150x150; manual uncertain review can be saved without model execution.
Fresh page import restores camera B, frame 104 / 16:45, selected B52, uncertain conclusion and note; review/view re-export is unchanged.
Hidden synthetic incident draft remains export-blocking, locator restores exact event and all/all filters; next Tab reaches local media input.
Saving located draft hides locator, permits export, and review decisions/history survive import and re-export.

visual_review.method: Actual viewport screenshots viewed using view_image.
findings: Light/dark originals, timestamps, model-not-run state, human note and restore notice remain legible.
Desktop draft toolbar remains one row; 390 px uses three controls then full-width export, with readable blocking message.
Located event title, risk/status, source and observation time are visible; mobile evidence filenames wrap without horizontal page overflow.

interface_regression.limitations: Local synthetic workflow and public-image decoding checks only; not model accuracy, actual resident evidence, remote CI or deployment validation.

limitations: 只验证Chromium 151/156的这些有界流程，不代表Safari/Firefox或任意缓存状态。
全输入gate保证拒绝提交断言可观察；持续推理时进度仍可能覆盖恢复拒绝提示，该产品可读性问题未在本轮修复。
HTTP500为受控故障，人工结论和交班文件为合成测试用例；真实公开图片推理不等于社区违规识别效果。
既有Linux/macOS MobileNet分数差仍超过原1e-6阈值，保留为失败；没有改模型、放宽阈值或把该项计为通过。
